snippet.title: LEIKKAUS: THE CUT - OUT ON STEAM 26th OCTOBER!
snippet.description:
When your financial minister picks up their scissors... run!

LEIKKAUS ("The Cut" in Finnish) is a horror game where all that you are trying to do is to collect your student benefit. But little did you know, that your benefit is not the only thing about to be cut

✂  Immersive Retro Horror: Explore the pixelated, dark, abandoned corridors of the old University building.

✂ Tense Gameplay: Your hunter will not give up on their prey easily.

✂ Cut for perfection: About one hour of entertainment and you should have your benefit... for now.

Add to your wishlist now, before it gets cut too!
